documents.text: formed squadrons with disestablished squadrons. Often however, the new squadron will assume the nickname, insignia, and traditions of the earlier squadrons. That appears to have happened in this case, as (for a short time) the new squadron used a cat insignia similar to the earlier one. Fighter Squadron 94 (VF-94), was established at NAS Alameda, California on March 26, 1952. The squadron began flying the Vought F4U Corsair, but quickly transitioned to jet aircraft.
